**Findings**

**Medium** - [review.go](/Users/peytonmontei/Documents/entire/devenv/entireio/cli/.worktrees/entire-review/cmd/entire/cli/review.go:651): `latestNonReviewAgent` calls `reader.ReadSessionContent` just to inspect `Metadata.Kind` and `Metadata.Agent`. For v2 checkpoints that reader loads raw transcripts and can fetch remote `/full/*` refs with a long timeout. That makes the “best-effort, never blocking launch” brief capable of delaying `entire review`; if transcript fetch fails, it also drops an otherwise available agent and renders `-`. Suggested fix: use/add a metadata-only v1/v2 helper for this path, or otherwise avoid transcript-loading reads in the renderer. Add a v2 test where `/main` metadata exists but raw transcript refs are absent.

**Low** - [review.go](/Users/peytonmontei/Documents/entire/devenv/entireio/cli/.worktrees/entire-review/cmd/entire/cli/review.go:781): detached HEAD committed changes are rendered inconsistently. `renderReviewBrief` can use `HeadSHA` for `BaseRef..head`, but `detectReviewScope` only populates ahead/file counts when `Branch != ""`, and [formatReviewScope](/Users/peytonmontei/Documents/entire/devenv/entireio/cli/.worktrees/entire-review/cmd/entire/cli/review.go:863) only shows vs-base counts for branch scopes. A detached HEAD with commits ahead of base can print “no changes detected” while the prompt includes commit rows. Suggested fix: compute counts against `HeadSHA`/`HEAD` for detached scopes, or avoid “no changes detected” when `BaseRef..HeadSHA` has commits.
